rubric_name: Voltmeter connected in parallel across the resistor under test

pass: voltmeter and resistor under test are both visible
both voltmeter terminals visibly reach the two different resistor nodes; a resistor node may be a binding post or a direct wire-to-resistor-lead junction
fail: a stable configuration directly shows that the voltmeter does not reach the two resistor nodes
abstained: a terminal, wire path, or resistor endpoint is occluded, outside the frame, or not traceable

visual_constraints: A wire crossing alone is not an electrical connection.
A direct wire-to-resistor-lead junction counts as a resistor endpoint when its association with that resistor is visible; a binding post is not required.
An absent or invisible connection is not evidence of failure.
Do not infer topology from the action label or from meter color alone.
